name: zendesk-exports
description: Check whether my Zendesk export is complete and explain missing comments, fields, tickets or mismatched dates. Use when you ask “is this Zendesk export complete?”, “why do CSV and JSON dates differ?”, or “why is my full JSON invalid?”. Review pasted records, readable archives and export settings against documented format limits. Identify missing files, comments, fields and pagination evidence. Works without an account connection. Not for customer replies, live synchronization or account changes.
